key_insight: Denoising diffusion models generate realistic additive-manufacturing microstructure images and support inverse mappings from properties or process conditions to microstructure.
engineering_relevance: Synthetic microstructures could support crystal-plasticity simulations and uncertainty quantification for faster AM materials qualification.
method: Use denoising diffusion probabilistic models to synthesize orientation-imaging micrographs.
Apply classifier-free guidance to property-to-structure and process-to-structure inverse problems.
Demonstrate a qualification-relevant uncertainty quantification application.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports quantitative evidence of generated-sample fidelity but provides no dataset sizes, evaluation metrics, or numerical results.
watch_item: Image fidelity alone does not establish accurate downstream mechanical predictions; simulation-based validation remains important.
paper_title: Microstructural Generative Inverse Models for Additive Manufacturing Digital Twins
